answer: The protocol imposes a dynamic opportunity-cost bond scaled by a zero-knowledge verifiable delay, locking staking collateral proportional to the attack horizon. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix assigns penalties exceeding any Sybil gain, yielding negative expected attack utility.
